milestone: MCP dashboard acceptance — corrected dispatch timestamp
objective: Physically accept the four-stage MCP activity pulse and stock-yield after fixing the stale pre-render dispatch timestamp exposed by 003/004.
why_this_shape: Same bounded dashboard/session/Host protocol as 004. Only the WSL runner timing bug is fixed: send cadence is now measured from actual dispatch time after source collection. Host hard floor remains 150 ms; client nominal cadence remains 200 ms; render tick remains 50 ms.

target.pairing_precheck: authenticated exact target required before any socket is created

transport.connection_shape: one persistent RFCOMM connection for this bounded session; one ACK per frame; no retry or reconnect
transport.one_controller_rule: the Android Divoom app must be disconnected for the whole session; OpenTivoo runtime/task/port 8779 remain untouched

build.installed_identity_note: Carried forward from verified deployment immediately before 003/004: repository and installed DLL byte-identical at this hash. 005 changes WSL Python only; Windows Host source/binary is unchanged, so no rebuild is required.

session.activation_source: the three MCP audit sources (optiplex_lab, optiplex_mcp, wsl_mcp), rendered by host/activity_render.py as the approved MCP page
session.shape: one connection; source collection remains at configured multi-second cadence; render tick every 50 ms; send ONLY when the rendered frame changes and client-side scheduler permits it, nominally no faster than 200 ms; Host independently refuses arrivals under 150 ms; one ACK per frame; then close
session.semantic_evidence: No new command semantics. Every frame uses the accepted stock-derived three-packet 0x44 image transaction; only pixels and accepted pacing differ.

budgets.derivation: 60 s at the actual 200 ms MCP client dispatch cadence admits at most 301 frame starts. Packets are 3 per frame. Current worst-case application transaction is 203 bytes including the two stock preambles, so 301 * 203 = 61103 bytes. The Host still independently enforces the 150 ms hard floor.
budgets.expected_realistic_frames: far below 301; change-only sending plus a few four-stage pulses

stop_immediately_on: any unsolicited state report on the link (canvas is no longer ours)
any inbound bytes that do not parse as exactly one valid wrapped report
any ACK that is not our wrapped 0x44 shape with a single payload byte
any send that does not complete in full
pairing precheck failure or any conflicting controller on the link
the worker falling silent for longer than the Host grace period
stop_policy.on_ambiguous_outcome: stop sending, close the link, record completed/unknown bytes and last known display state; never resend, reconnect, or reclaim
stop_policy.recovery: operator-initiated only after outcome is recorded; returning to stock is never a command we send

expected_observations.physical: approved L/mushroom, O/bunny, W/skull dashboard; on activity, that column crown + letter + icon accent visibly cycle cyan -> blue -> light blue -> cyan over four ACKed stages (~0.60 s) then return to status colour
expected_observations.stock_yield: after the operator has seen a full pulse, one physical Ditoo control is pressed; the session should stop immediately, send no reclaim frame, and report unknown_not_ours / stopped_yielded_to_stock
expected_observations.fault_bar: if a source genuinely becomes unavailable, its crown row shows the red fault bar and no activity crown; otherwise remains NOT TESTED
expected_observations.ack_payload: recorded per frame, never treated as a success constant
expected_observations.animation_expectation: One active column should visibly progress cyan -> blue -> light-blue -> cyan over roughly 0.8 s, then return to status colour.

acceptance_criteria.visual_pulse: operator sees at least one complete four-stage pulse on crown + letter + icon accent and confirms it returns to base status colour
acceptance_criteria.pacing: Host enforces no frame starts under 150 ms and each frame remains ACK-gated
acceptance_criteria.stock_yield: after one intentional physical control, session terminates without retry/reconnect/reclaim and no later frame is sent
acceptance_criteria.transport: one connection, three packets per sent frame, one wrapped 0x44 ACK per completed frame, bounded accounting agrees
acceptance_criteria.collection_survives: after display stop, activity-status still collects
acceptance_criteria.authority_is_consumed: both WSL claim and Host ledger make this experiment id one-use
acceptance_criteria.fault_signal: only claim PASS if a real source failure occurs; otherwise record NOT TESTED
acceptance_criteria.pacing_acceptance: No HTTP 429 pacing refusal; all actual client dispatch starts are at least 200 ms apart by client monotonic scheduling while Host independently enforces 150 ms.
acceptance_criteria.stock_yield_acceptance: after the operator has visually confirmed the session is live, pressing one physical Ditoo control causes the session to stop/yield, display state becomes unknown_not_ours, no later frame is sent, and no reclaim occurs.
acceptance_criteria.visual_acceptance: operator confirms approved page plus one complete four-stage cyan/blue/light-blue/cyan pulse on any active column.

preconditions: DONE 2026-09-09: Windows Host remains the previously identity-verified fb750078... build; no Host source changed for 005
DONE 2026-09-09: stale pre-render dispatch timestamp fixed and regression-tested with 350 ms simulated source collection
DONE 2026-09-09: offline verifier PASS with 153 tests
operator present and watching the unit

authority.grant_scope_requested: ONE execution only: up to 60 seconds; change-only MCP dashboard; 50 ms render tick; client dispatch nominally no faster than 200 ms measured from actual dispatch; Host hard floor 150 ms; at most 301 frames / 903 packets / 61103 application bytes; one RFCOMM connection; one ACK per frame; fixed 10 ms intra-frame spacing; no retry, reconnect, reclaim, pipelining, streaming, unattended operation, or second attempt.

explicitly_out_of_scope: pipelining or more than one frame in flight
any frame-start policy faster than 150 ms
firmware update, persistent upload, service/MassBoot, teardown

supersedes.why: 004 authority is consumed after the stale pre-render timestamp pacing failure; 005 is a new manifest/new id.
